slides.title: Broadcasting in Action 📢
slides.content:
# Sending to All

With the connection manager, you can broadcast messages to all connected clients. This is the foundation of chat rooms and real-time dashboards.

slides.title: Broadcast Endpoint

quizData.question: What is the purpose of broadcasting?

options.text: To send a message to a single client
To send a message to all connected clients

quizData.explanation: Broadcasting sends the same message to every active WebSocket connection.
